router.sh.content:
export PREFILL_NODE_1=`hostname -i`
export DECODE_NODE_1=`hostname -i`


vllm-router --policy consistent_hash \
    --vllm-pd-disaggregation \
    --prefill http://$PREFILL_NODE_1:8001 \
    --decode http://$DECODE_NODE_1:8002 \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 30000 \
    --intra-node-data-parallel-size 4
